title: gagnebina bernieriana
intro: Gagnebina bernieriana, commonly known as the Himalayan pennywort or Gagnepain's pennywort, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of G. bernieriana include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and neuroprotective properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
